mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate relative to its 12-month moving average signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces the cost of capital for corporations, leading to higher equity valuations and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where FEDFUNDS is declining relative to 12-month MA, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate above 5.5% within a 3-month window signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending power and corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods where UNRATE exceeds 5.5%, or Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates a broad-based contraction in consumer and business spending, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days due to reduced economic activity and corporate revenue expectations.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods where both HOUST and RSAFS decline > 0.5%, or interaction Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During a post-pandemic recovery phase, a sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) above its 6-month moving average signals improving manufacturing output and supply chain normalization, supporting corporate earnings growth and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods classified as post-pandemic recovery, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year increase in the CPI (CPIAUCSL) above 2.5% signals persistent inflation that prompts the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days due to immediate market repricing.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods where CPIAUCSL YoY exceeds 2.5%, or Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and CPI (CPIAUCSL) above their respective 12-month moving averages indicates an aggressive monetary tightening cycle amid persistent inflation, compressing equity valuations and causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS above 12-month MA and CPIAUCSL above 12-month MA
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods where both FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL are above their 12-month MAs, or interaction Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In an early-cycle expansion, a sustained increase in real personal consumption (RSAFS) above its 3-month moving average signals strong consumer demand that boosts corporate sales and earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods classified as early-cycle expansion, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) relative to its 12-month moving average indicates robust manufacturing activity that supports corporate output and profit growth, resulting in positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where INDPRO is above its 12-month moving average, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.
